description: This file defines a Python module for tracing function calls with remote logging capabilities, including a Tracer class with methods for decorating functions, capturing call details, and sending logs asynchronously.

classes.name: Tracer
classes.description: A class providing functionality to trace Python function calls, capture execution details, and send logs to a remote server.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the Tracer with repository URL and optional server base URL.

methods.name: trace_endpoint
methods.description: Decorator to wrap functions for tracing their calls and execution.

methods.name: _send_trace_log
methods.description: Asynchronously sends the collected trace data to the configured endpoint.

methods.name: _serialize_variable
methods.description: Serializes a variable to JSON-compatible format, handling exceptions.

methods.name: _get_file_tag
methods.description: Determines if a file is from standard library, external library, or internal code based on path.

methods.name: _setup_trace
methods.description: Sets up the tracing function with context.

methods.name: _capture_arguments
methods.description: Captures and serializes function arguments from a frame.

methods.name: _trace_function_calls
methods.description: Handles tracing of function call, return, and exception events, recording relevant data.
